market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain under pressure from Iran escalation and Fed rate-hike expectations. Oil above recent highs sustains inflation fears. Expect continued bond volatility and equity risk-off into mid-September. Key watch: whether Hormuz tensions de-escalate or escalate. 10Y Treasury yield is the single most important variable.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle (Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI) supports multi-year tech earnings growth. India as China-risk hedge gains structural tailwind. Consumer stress may moderate as rate cycle peaks. Prediction markets and crypto institutionalization represent new asset-class maturation. Apple leadership transition is a one-time event with limited long-term impact.
